candidate_windows.window_text:
For the mQG model, we use the MQS loss of the validation set as the selecting criteria. For the mQG models without MQS loss, we use MLE loss as the selecting criteria. Total training time was about 3 hours with 1 RTX A6000 GPU. We initialize the mQG model with pretrained BART-large, which has 406M parameters. Hyperparameters are follow: learning rate $= 5\mathrm{e - }6$ ; batch size $= 8$ ; epoch $= 15$

We use RoBERTa-large model for BERTScore and BLEURT-20 model for BLEURT. For the evaluation model, we load SQuAD 2.0 finetuned DeBERTa-base model $^{3}$ , which has 86M parameters, to further finetune. Total training time was about an hour with 1 RTX A6000 GPU. Hyperparameters are follow: learning rate $= 5\mathrm{e - }6$ batch size $= 16$ ; epoch $= 8$
